# anyword

> Micro text segmenter for JavaScript and TypeScript, built on native `Intl.Segmenter`. Splits, counts and truncates text by word, grapheme or sentence, correctly in any locale. Zero dependencies, under 1kb gzip, ESM + CJS, SSR-safe.

anyword exists because naive JavaScript quietly gets text wrong:

- `"👨‍👩‍👧".length` is `8`, not `1` — `.length` counts UTF-16 code units, not characters users see.
- `"世界test".split(/\s+/)` finds one "word" — scripts without spaces need real boundary rules.
- `[...str]` rips composite emoji and combining accents apart.
- `str.slice(0, 140)` can cut an emoji in half and produce mojibake.

`Intl.Segmenter` knows where the real boundaries are. anyword is the thin wrapper over it — no rule tables, no locale files, no config.

## Install

```bash
npm install anyword
```

## API

- `anyword(text, options?): string[]` — segments as plain strings.
- `anywordParts(text, options?): { segment, index, isWordLike? }[]` — segments with offsets into the original text.
- `anywordCount(text, options?): number` — number of segments.
- `anywordTruncate(text, limit, options?): string` — cut to at most `limit` segments, never mid-emoji.
- `supported: boolean` — whether `Intl.Segmenter` exists in this runtime.

Options: `by` (`"word" | "grapheme" | "sentence"`, default `"word"`; `anywordTruncate` defaults to `"grapheme"`), `locale` (BCP 47 tag or fallback array, default runtime locale), `raw` (word mode: keep spaces and punctuation, default `false`), `ellipsis` (`anywordTruncate` only, default `""`).

```ts
import { anyword, anywordCount, anywordTruncate } from "anyword";

anyword("don't stop 世界");                    // ["don't", "stop", "世界"]
anyword("👨‍👩‍👧 hi", { by: "grapheme" });         // ["👨‍👩‍👧", " ", "h", "i"]
anywordCount("👨‍👩‍👧", { by: "grapheme" });      // 1
anywordTruncate("héllo 👨‍👩‍👧", 5, { ellipsis: "…" }); // "héllo…"
```

## Use it when

- Counting characters for a length limit the way users count them (emoji = 1).
- Counting words in text that may be Chinese, Japanese or Thai.
- Truncating a preview or bio without breaking an emoji or an accented letter.
- Splitting text into sentences.
- Animating text per character with emoji intact.
- Reversing a string safely.

Not an NLP toolkit: no stemming, no stop words, no message catalogs.

## Docs

- [Full reference in one file](https://anyword-three.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): every function, option and edge case as plain markdown.
- [Interactive demo and docs](https://anyword-three.vercel.app/): live segmentation playground.
- [README on GitHub](https://github.com/kirilinsky/anyword): source, tests, CI.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/anyword): install and versions.

## Compatibility

Node.js 18+ · Chrome 87+ · Firefox 125+ · Safari 14.1+ · Deno · Cloudflare Workers · Vercel Edge Runtime. On runtimes without `Intl.Segmenter` every function throws — check the exported `supported` flag first.
